value.rationale: This is a natural nontrivial stability question at the globally maximizing seven-vertex configuration identified by recent work. Its full tangent spectrum identifies all geometric stiffness modes and the exact sharp quadratic volume-deficit coefficient modulo rotations, not derivable numerically or as an immediate corollary of a global maximum statement. It supplies useful local sensitivity data for a first-open-case extremal 4-polytope problem.
